interpretation.admission: Original native 24bp/side full C<R and >=48bp R/fill; first admitted entry only, same timestamp and R in every arm. Sensitivities retain primary entries.
interpretation.entry: Use same next executable fresh quote as baseline, never an earlier decision quote. Fade buy at ask and sell at bid. Original quantity and R retained.
interpretation.horizons: 4h means existing registered observation boundary, not four hours after fill. Oil inherited native quotes start07:00 before13:00-17:00 window. 72 elapsed hours from fill, not three trading sessions; weekend hours count.
interpretation.baseline: No native session clock close before the tick boundary; unresolved ticks censored. Additional explicit MTM arm uses first fresh boundary quote within5s, broker bracket first.
interpretation.continuation: Only subsequent contiguous M30 bars starting exactly at tick boundary; stop at first absent bar, uncertain intrabar order, partial deadline bar or end of cache. Never infer holiday/weekend continuity.
interpretation.bar_model: M30 interpreted as bid OHLC; short ask exits use frozen recorded entry spread proxy. Existing bracket first at bar open; adverse gaps use observed open, TP capped at target. Stop/target or +1R-and-return ambiguity stays unresolved. No synthetic OHLC tick path.
interpretation.bar_amend: After trigger with no ambiguous return, a distinct favourable closing price proves a later quote; equal extreme/close leaves amend timing ambiguous and unresolved. Short proxy and intrabar execution remain unqualified.
interpretation.costs: Bid/ask tick fills include spread once. M30 short asks use entry-spread proxy once. Charge (entry+exit)*bps/10000/R. Zero extra commission inherited, financing/overnight swap and historical spread unavailable; rates uncalibrated.
interpretation.evidence: Previously observed development cache, retrospectively chosen hypotheses, protocol flags retained. Not untouched validation or account qualification.

post_run_assessment.scope: 159 requested cached tick episodes; four lack M30 preparation,155 have preparation
post_run_assessment.decision_option_a: Rejected for deployment under these tested assumptions; simple direction inversion worsened matched-entry outcomes.
post_run_assessment.decision_option_b: Inconclusive: no continuation bars exist for the sole in-scope unclosed entry. Zero real M30 resolutions; equality to baseline is not evidence of an effective72h policy.
post_run_assessment.decision_option_ab: Fade losses persist; the multi-day extension remains unevaluated on an actual open path.
post_run_assessment.primary_versus_sensitivity: Lower same-fill costs improve breakout expectancy, but its closed-only hit rate remains3/7. Rates are uncalibrated and two of those three winners have inherited source-protocol flags.
post_run_assessment.next: Keep live rules unchanged. Calibrate actual round-trip costs and obtain an authorised executable continuation path before judging72h holds. Do not promote or retune a generic fade on this reused tiny sample.
